opening.argument: The title identifies this as a Netflix France trailer for Grace and Frankie season 6, and the description says the series returns on Netflix. The dialogue is consistent with scripted scenes from the show, while the request to subscribe to the Netflix France YouTube channel is ordinary audience engagement. Nothing in that request makes subscription a condition for money, private data, investment participation, or a promised benefit. The trailer's branding and availability message promote an entertainment release; they do not turn the channel subscription request into a transactional offer.
